subject: Session Anchor
fact: The events occur during a single continuous journey through the web network, with no temporal markers other than 'after an hour of walking' and 'when the goblins return breathless and pleased.'
source_quote: After an hour of walking, Daz notices a cocoon. ... When the goblins return breathless and pleased, they turn to Jimjar.

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 7th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493.
source_quote: 7th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: session memory
fact: The group recalls a childhood game called 'Cut the Graph,' which mirrors their current environmental challenge, implying that past experiences inform their present decisions under pressure.
source_quote: They remember this as a game from their childhood called 'Cut the Graph.'

subject: Burning Web Risk Protocol
fact: The group establishes a safety protocol for navigating fire-damaged web segments: rope tying, sequential fall arrest, and acceptance of potential mutual death.
source_quote: Well, then the next person must. ... Then I suppose we all die. ... Gnarly.

subject: Cocoon Investigation
fact: The discovery of the moving cocoon triggers a coordinated action: Stool and Grygum approach it with spores, marking the first active threat response of the journey.
source_quote: We need those spores. ... Yes, I will. Now let’s go together.

subject: Cut the Graph game reference
fact: The group recalls a childhood game called 'Cut the Graph,' where cutting the wrong strands traps players, and cutting the right ones enables escape.
source_quote: They remember this as a game from their childhood called ‘Cut the Graph.’

subject: Daz
fact: Daz notices Topsy and Turvy talking to each other but cannot understand what they are saying.
source_quote: Daz notices Topsy and Turvy talking to each other. But they are too far away for him to understand what they are saying.

subject: Daz creates ice water blocks
fact: Daz creates blocks of ice from a pool of water, using all available water.
source_quote: Thorin finds a pool of water. Daz immediately starts creating blocks of water for the group. When all the blocks are made, there is no more water.

subject: Daz intervenes in bet
fact: Daz reminds Zalthir that gambling violates his monk vows.
source_quote: Daz steps in, “It’s my understanding that Zalthir vowed never to gamble again when he became a monk. And such a bet would violate his oaths.”

subject: Daz proposes ice water solution
fact: Daz proposes using his ability to shape water into blocks of ice for transport and consumption.
source_quote: Daz then proposes an ingenious solution. When they next find water, he will use his ability to shape water to transform it into a block of ice.

subject: drow wizard history
fact: A past Drow wizard attempted to burn the Silken Paths, but the spiders rebuilt the webs faster than he could destroy them.
source_quote: Do you remember that crazy Drow wizard who wanted to burn this place down? But the spiders kept rebuilding it faster than he could burn.

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth mutters that they can tie silk rope around each other to mitigate falls.
source_quote: Eldeth, who has done some spelunking, mutters, “We can tie some of the silk rope around each of us. That way, if one of us falls, the others can try to arrest his fall.”

subject: Eldeth accepts risk of death
fact: Eldeth responds that if all fail to arrest a fall, then they all die.
source_quote: “Then I suppose we all die.”

subject: Eldeth explains cascade fall protocol
fact: Eldeth states that if one person fails to arrest a fall, the next must try, and if all fail, everyone dies.
source_quote: Well, then the next person must." ... "Then I suppose we all die.

subject: Eldeth proposes silk rope safety system
fact: Eldeth suggests tying silk rope around each person to arrest falls from the web.
source_quote: We can tie some of the silk rope around each of us. That way, if one of us falls, the others can try to arrest his fall.

subject: Eldeth proposes silk safety lines
fact: Eldeth suggests tying silk rope around each person to arrest falls from the webs.
source_quote: We can tie some of the silk rope around each of us. That way, if one of us falls, the others can try to arrest his fall.

subject: fall mitigation strategy
fact: Eldeth proposes tying silk rope around each person to arrest falls, with backup responsibility passed sequentially if initial attempts fail.
source_quote: We can tie some of the silk rope around each of us. That way, if one of us falls, the others can try to arrest his fall. ... Well, then the next person must. ... Then I suppose we all die.

subject: Fargas offers tomb location
fact: Fargas offers the location of a lost tomb and its treasure in exchange for rescue.
source_quote: I have information. We were coming to look for a tomb. I know the location of the tomb. And more importantly, I know the location of the treasure.

subject: Fargas Rumblefoot
fact: Fargas Rumblefoot realizes he might not be freed and offers information about a tomb and treasure.
source_quote: Fargas suddenly realizes he might not be freed, “I have information. We were coming to look for a tomb. I know the location of the tomb. And more importantly, I know the location of the treasure.”

subject: Fargas Rumblefoot
fact: Fargas Rumblefoot says he can feel the spiders coming.
source_quote: Shit, I can feel the spiders coming.

subject: Fargas Rumblefoot
fact: Fargas Rumblefoot says he escaped the gnolls because they usually just eat their victims.
source_quote: Because I escaped. Most of the time, the gnolls just eat their victims.

subject: Fargas Rumblefoot
fact: Fargas Rumblefoot says he is not infected by gnoll spawn.
source_quote: I am not infected.

subject: Fargas Rumblefoot
fact: Fargas Rumblefoot's voice pleads in their heads to be freed from the cocoon.
source_quote: they hear the voice of a still living halfling in their heads. “I am Fargas Rumblefoot.” ... “Can you please get me out of here?”

subject: Fargas Rumblefoot rescue
fact: Fargas Rumblefoot, a halfling trapped in a cocoon, claims to be uninfected by gnolls and possesses knowledge of a lost tomb and its treasure, pleading for rescue as spiders approach.
source_quote: I am Fargas Rumblefoot. ... I was a member of an adventuring band looking for a lost tomb. Gnolls attacked us. ... I am not infected. ... I am spider snack for later. ... I have information. We were coming to look for a tomb. I know the location of the tomb. And more importantly, I know the location of the treasure.

subject: Fargas senses spiders approaching
fact: Fargas Rumblefoot senses spiders approaching while still in the cocoon.
source_quote: Shit, I can feel the spiders coming.

subject: Fargas’s revelation
fact: Fargas, moments before being potentially consumed by spiders, reveals he has vital information about the tomb and its treasure, shifting the group’s priorities from immediate survival to strategic gain.
source_quote: I have information. We were coming to look for a tomb. I know the location of the tomb. And more importantly, I know the location of the treasure.

subject: gnoll origin lore
fact: Gnolls are feral hyena-headed humanoids created when the demon lord Yeenoghu came to Faerûn; their spawn are gestated in hyenas and burst from their bodies upon birth.
source_quote: Gnolls attack without warning, slaughtering their victims and devouring their flesh. It is said that spawns are put into a hyena, and when the spawn is born, it rips out of the hyena's body. It is also said that hyenas are one of many species that can be used to store the spawn of gnolls. It is also said that they were created when the demon lord Yeenoghu found his way onto Faerûn and ran amok.

subject: goblin betting agreement
fact: Jimjar bets Yukyuk and Spiderbait 20 gold that they cannot navigate the spiderwebs, and they accept, though Jimjar lacks the funds and plans to pay later.
source_quote: Jimjar, “I’ll bet you 20 gold you can’t navigate the spiderwebs.” ... “Done!” ... But I am a bit short of cash.

subject: goblin guide competence
fact: Yukyuk and Spiderbait are highly competent navigators of the Silken Paths, using specialized techniques to avoid spiders and traverse unstable strands.
source_quote: They are good at surfing the web. ... I went around the spider and through its legs.

subject: goblin guide introduction
fact: Yukyuk and Spiderbait are goblin guides dressed in relaxed clothing, wearing beanies, covered in draconic-script tattoos (mistakenly used for goblin words), and offer guidance for 2 gold per day.
source_quote: They are dressed in relaxed, comfortable shoes, baggy pants, and shirts whose button reaches just above their knees, whose sleeves are particularly wide, and their heads are covered with beanies. Their bodies are covered in tattoos written in draconic. The spelling is wrong. And it’s only through happenstance that Zalthir realizes they are writing goblin words using a draconic script. ... My name is Yukyuk. ... And I am Spiderbait. We can be your guides at a nominal price of 2 gold per day.

subject: goblin guide personality shift
fact: After the betting agreement, Yukyuk and Spiderbait’s formal demeanor dissolves into casual, enthusiastic speech, revealing their genuine excitement and competence.
source_quote: Oh, yeah, man. That was fun. ... We are the best. We are going to have so much fun going through the web with you. And you are an awesome group.

subject: goblin guide retention agreement
fact: Yukyuk and Spiderbait agree to remain with the group until Jimjar can pay the 20 gold debt.
source_quote: Jimjar, how about we be your guides and hang around until you have the 20 gold you owe?

subject: goblins accept Jimjar's bet
fact: Yukyuk and Spiderbait accept Jimjar’s 20 gold bet to navigate the webs.
source_quote: “Done!”

subject: goblins agree to guide until paid
fact: Spiderbait proposes the goblins guide the group until Jimjar can pay the 20 gold.
source_quote: Jimjar, how about we be your guides and hang around until you have the 20 gold you owe?

subject: goblins demonstrate web-surfing
fact: Yukyuk and Spiderbait coat their shoes and run across the spiderwebs to demonstrate navigation.
source_quote: Thorin observes them coat their shoes with a peculiar substance and start running.

subject: goblins explain fire danger on web
fact: Yukyuk and Spiderbait explain that fire burns the web and kills anyone within 30 feet.
source_quote: fire can burn through the web, but when it does, anyone within 30 feet of the burning point will likely fall to their death.

subject: goblins explain web traversal
fact: Yukyuk and Spiderbait explain that walking is the way to cross the webs, not surfing.
source_quote: Oh man, you’re not surfing. You’re walking.

subject: goblins navigate webs successfully
fact: Yukyuk and Spiderbait successfully navigate the spiderwebs, coating their shoes with a peculiar substance.
source_quote: Thorin observes them coat their shoes with a peculiar substance and start running.

subject: goblins note safety line idea

source_quote: This innovation intrigues the goblins, who take many mental notes as the escapees tie themselves.

subject: goblins offer guiding services
fact: Yukyuk and Spiderbait offer to guide the group across the Silken Paths for 2 gold per day.
source_quote: We can be your guides at a nominal price of 2 gold per day.

subject: goblins propose working until paid
fact: Spiderbait proposes the goblins act as guides until Jimjar can pay the 20 gold.
source_quote: Spiderbait, however, has an idea: “Jimjar, how about we be your guides and hang around until you have the 20 gold you owe?”

subject: goblins take mental notes on silk rope
fact: The goblins take mental notes as the group ties silk rope around themselves.
source_quote: This innovation intrigues the goblins, who take many mental notes as the escapees tie themselves.

source_quote: Zalthir asks, “And can we mitigate that fall?” ... The two goblins shrug. But Eldeth, who has done some spelunking, mutters, “We can tie some of the silk rope around each of us. That way, if one of us falls, the others can try to arrest his fall.”

subject: goblin web-surfing demonstration
fact: Yukyuk and Spiderbait navigate the spiderwebs using a peculiar substance on their shoes, demonstrating advanced web-surfing techniques, including twisting, flipping, and threading through spider legs.
source_quote: Thorin observes them coat their shoes with a peculiar substance and start running. ... They are good at surfing the web. ... I went around the spider and through its legs.

subject: group admits destitution
fact: Daz admits the group is destitute and cannot pay the goblins.
source_quote: Daz admits, “We are destitute.”

fact: Spiders are walking on the web strands, which can be cut with fire or blade to escape or trap.
source_quote: Spiders are walking on strands. Those strands can be cut with fire or a blade. They can stop the spiders and escape if they cut the strands in the right places. They will get trapped if they cut the strands in the wrong place.

subject: group recalls 'Cut the Graph'

source_quote: Buppido mutters, ‘I am not sure the divine plan had anything about relying on two semi-sentient goblins for our safety.’ For once, Zalthir agrees.

subject: Silken Paths description
fact: The Silken Paths are a network of spider webs crisscrossing a 500-foot-deep, 2,000-foot-wide chasm that stretches for nearly five miles. The major strands of the web are traversable. Still, the Silken Paths are ever-changing because old webs disintegrate over time and the giant spiders inhabiting the chasm constantly spin new ones.
source_quote: The Silken Paths are a network of spider webs crisscrossing a 500-foot-deep, 2,000-foot-wide chasm that stretches for nearly five miles. The major strands of the web are traversable. Still, the Silken Paths are ever-changing because old webs disintegrate over time and the giant spiders inhabiting the chasm constantly spin new ones.

subject: spider avoidance mechanics
fact: Spiders on the web are attracted to vibrations, but the sheer volume of activity on the webs masks the party’s movements.
source_quote: Yeah, dude. But there is so much stuff bouncing on the webs that they won’t notice your bouncing scales.

subject: Spiderbait questions fall protocol
fact: Spiderbait asks what happens if multiple people fail to arrest a fall.
source_quote: But what if the other guy can stop the fall? ... And what if he fails? And what if you all fail?

subject: Thorin questions gnoll infection

source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Trillimac mushroom description
fact: Trillimac is a mushroom that grows to a height of four to five feet and has a broad gray-green cap and a light gray stalk. The cap’s leathery surface can be cut and cleaned for use in making maps, hats, and scrolls (its surface takes on dyes and inks well). The stalk can be cleaned, soaked in water for an hour, then dried to make a palatable food akin to bread.
source_quote: Jimjar, a botanist, explains it is a mushroom that grows to a height of four to five feet and has a broad gray-green cap and a light gray stalk. The cap’s leathery surface can be cut and cleaned for use in making maps, hats, and scrolls (its surface takes on dyes and inks well). The stalk can be cleaned, soaked in water for an hour, then dried to make a palatable food akin to bread.

subject: Web Navigation Agreement
fact: The group formally hires Yukyuk and Spiderbait as guides for 2 gold per day; the deal is sealed with mutual agreement; the goblins’ formal demeanor dissolves into enthusiastic camaraderie.

fact: Zalthir believes Jimjar is an infinite cash machine and that if he can get Jimjar to take the side of bets, he is most likely to win.

subject: Zalthir’s betting pattern analysis

subject: Drow
fact: The Drow are an ever-present threat in the Underdark, whose patrols the escapees are trying to evade. Their presence motivates the group’s stealth and route choices.
source_quote: Are you not interested in avoiding the drow?

subject: Drow Wizards
fact: A past Drow wizard attempted to burn the web network but failed due to the spiders’ rapid regeneration; referenced as a cautionary tale about the web’s resilience.
source_quote: Do you remember that crazy Drow wizard who wanted to burn this place down? But the spiders kept rebuilding it faster than he could burn.

subject: Gnolls
fact: Gnolls are a feral, hyena-headed humanoid race that attack without warning, slaughter their victims, and devour their flesh. They are said to use hyenas as hosts for spawning, and their origin is linked to the demon lord Yeenoghu’s incursion onto Faerûn.
source_quote: Gnolls attacked us. Feral hyena-headed humanoids attack without warning, slaughtering their victims and devouring their flesh. It is said that spawns are put into a hyena, and when the spawn is born, it rips out of the hyena's body. It is also said that hyenas are one of many species that can be used to store the spawn of gnolls. It is also said that they were created when the demon lord Yeenoghu found his way onto Faerûn and ran amok.

subject: goblins
fact: Yukyuk and Spiderbait offer to guide the group across the Silken Paths for 2 gold per day.
source_quote: We can be your guides at a nominal price of 2 gold per day.

subject: Yeenoghu

source_quote: It is also said that they were created when the demon lord Yeenoghu found his way onto Faerûn and ran amok.

subject: Darklake

source_quote: It is a fungus called “Ormu. In addition to shedding a dim light for 5 feet, it can be harvested, dried, and made into a phosphorescent powder or pigment.”

source_quote: The Silken Paths are a network of spider webs crisscrossing a 500-foot-deep, 2,000-foot-wide chasm that stretches for nearly five miles.

subject: Sloobludop

subject: Sloobludop

source_quote: Take us to a passageway that will get us quickly to Sloobludop.

subject: The Lost Tomb
fact: The lost tomb is the original objective of Fargas’s adventuring band. Its location is known to Fargas and is tied to a greater treasure, making it a critical piece of information in the current dilemma.
source_quote: We were coming to look for a tomb. I know the location of the tomb. And more importantly, I know the location of the treasure.

subject: The Web Network
fact: The Web Network is a vast, sentient-seeming labyrinth of silk strands inhabited by giant spiders; fire destroys it temporarily but it regenerates faster; climbing cliffs is a fallback but discouraged; walking is the intended path.
source_quote: The web is the way to go. Just gotta avoid the spiders. ... When the webs were burned, you had to climb down these gnarly cliffs. And then climb up some other cliffs.

subject: Trillimac mushroom
fact: Trillimac mushroom has a leathery cap usable for maps, hats, and scrolls, and a stalk that can be dried into bread-like food.
source_quote: Jimjar, a botanist, explains it is a mushroom that grows to a height of four to five feet and has a broad gray-green cap and a light gray stalk. The cap’s leathery surface can be cut and cleaned for use in making maps, hats, and scrolls (its surface takes on dyes and inks well). The stalk can be cleaned, soaked in water for an hour, then dried to make a palatable food akin to bread.

subject: Trillimac mushroom patch
fact: A patch of Trillimac mushrooms yields 20 pounds of food.
source_quote: there is more Trillimac, enough to make 20 pounds of food.

subject: Underdark
fact: The Underdark is the vast, lightless subterranean realm through which the escapees are traveling. It is home to dangerous creatures, strange flora, and hidden paths.
source_quote: As the caravan of escapees moves through the Underdark...

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: chasme
fact: Chasme is referenced as a dangerous Underdark creature.
source_quote: chasme

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: Cocoon
fact: A humanoid-sized, moving cocoon is discovered in the web maze; prompts the deployment of Stool’s spores; suggests the presence of a captured or transforming entity.
source_quote: Zalthir notices it is moving and humanoid-sized. ... We need those spores.

subject: giant spiders
fact: Giant spiders are present on the Silken Paths and can be avoided by not triggering vibrations.
source_quote: Yeah, dude. But there is so much stuff bouncing on the webs that they won’t notice your bouncing scales.

subject: giant spiders
fact: Giant spiders can be attracted by vibrations on the web.
source_quote: But when we walk on the web, the spiders will hear our vibrations. Won’t that attract them to us?

subject: giant spiders
fact: Giant spiders can be spun by the goblin guides for extra points.
source_quote: You get extra points if you spin a spider.

subject: giant spiders
fact: Giant spiders inhabit the Silken Paths and constantly spin new webs as old ones disintegrate.
source_quote: The major strands of the web are traversable. Still, the Silken Paths are ever-changing because old webs disintegrate over time and the giant spiders inhabiting the chasm constantly sping new ones.

subject: giant spiders
fact: Giant spiders inhabit the Silken Paths and rebuild webs faster than they can be burned.
source_quote: Not the small kind, but the giant kind. ... Do you remember that crazy Drow wizard who wanted to burn this place down? But the spiders kept rebuilding it faster than he could burn.

subject: Giant spiders
fact: Giant spiders inhabit the Silken Paths chasm and continuously spin new webs, causing the structure to be ever-changing and dangerous. They are the reason the web network is unstable.
source_quote: The major strands of the web are traversable. Still, the Silken Paths are ever-changing because old webs disintegrate over time and the giant spiders inhabiting the chasm constantly spin new ones.

subject: Giant Spiders
fact: Giant spiders inhabit the web network; rebuild faster than fire can destroy it; are sensitive to vibrations but distracted by other movement; and are not to be provoked or mistaken for small spiders.
source_quote: Not the small kind, but the giant kind. You get extra points if you spin a spider. ... The spiders kept rebuilding it faster than he could burn. ... They won’t notice your bouncing scales.

subject: gnolls
fact: Gnolls are feral hyena-headed humanoids that attack without warning and devour their victims.
source_quote: Feral hyena-headed humanoids attack without warning, slaughtering their victims and devouring their flesh.

subject: gnolls
fact: Gnolls are feral hyena-headed humanoids that attack without warning, devour flesh, and are said to be spawned from hyenas.
source_quote: Feral hyena-headed humanoids attack without warning, slaughtering their victims and devouring their flesh. It is said that spawns are put into a hyena, and when the spawn is born, it rips out of the hyena's body. It is also said that hyenas are one of many species that can be used to store the spawn of gnolls.

subject: gnolls
fact: Gnolls are said to have been created when the demon lord Yeenoghu came to Faerûn.
source_quote: It is also said that they were created when the demon lord Yeenoghu found his way onto Faerûn and ran amok.

subject: Gnoll Spawn
fact: Gnoll spawn are parasitic entities said to be implanted into hyenas, where they gestate and burst forth upon birth, a process tied to Yeenoghu’s dark magic and the gnolls’ reproductive horror.
source_quote: It is said that spawns are put into a hyena, and when the spawn is born, it rips out of the hyena's body.

subject: gnoll spawn
fact: Gnoll spawn are said to be implanted in hyenas and erupt from their bodies upon birth.
source_quote: It is said that spawns are put into a hyena, and when the spawn is born, it rips out of the hyena's body.

subject: Goblins
fact: Two goblins appear at the Silken Paths, dressed in loose clothing and covered in tattoos written in a corrupted draconic script that actually spells goblin words. Their presence suggests possible scouts or local inhabitants.
source_quote: Two goblins appear. They are dressed in relaxed, comfortable shoes... their bodies are covered in tattoos written in draconic. The spelling is wrong. And it’s only through happenstance that Zalthir realizes they are writing goblin words using a draconic script.

subject: gray ooze
fact: Gray ooze is mentioned as a hazard in the Underdark.
source_quote: gray ooze

subject: Spiders
fact: Spiders are moving along silk strands in the environment, capable of being stopped or escaped from by cutting the strands with fire or a blade — but cutting the wrong strands will trap the group.
source_quote: Spiders are walking on strands. Those strands can be cut with fire or a blade. They can stop the spiders and escape if they cut the strands in the right places. They will get trapped if they cut the strands in the wrong place.

subject: Trillimac mushroom
fact: Trillimac is a mushroom that grows four to five feet tall with a gray-green cap and light gray stalk.
source_quote: Jimjar, a botanist, explains it is a mushroom that grows to a height of four to five feet and has a broad gray-green cap and a light gray stalk.

subject: vrock
fact: Vrock is referenced as a dangerous Underdark creature.
source_quote: vrock

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido expresses doubt about relying on the goblins for safety.
source_quote: I am not sure the divine plan had anything about relying on two semi-sentient goblins for our safety.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido is fascinated by Eldeth’s trail-obscuring techniques and later asks Sathir for clarification on the nature of the Silken Paths, showing curiosity about environmental features.
source_quote: Buppido asks, 'Although I know what they are, what do you think they are, Sathir?'

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido is particularly interested in Eldeth's tricks of obscuring their trail.
source_quote: Buppido seems particularly interested in her tricks.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido mutters that he is not sure the divine plan involved relying on the goblins for safety.
source_quote: Buppido mutters, “I am not sure the divine plan had anything about relying on two semi-sentient goblins for our safety.”

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido voices theological unease about relying on semi-sentient goblins for safety; is one of the few to explicitly question the divine plan’s alignment with their current strategy.
source_quote: I am not sure the divine plan had anything about relying on two semi-sentient goblins for our safety.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz admits to being destitute, nods in agreement with Zalthir’s concerns about payment and survival, and notices a moving cocoon, prompting the need for spores.
source_quote: We are destitute. ... It’s almost as if we are on a Safari that surfs the web. ... Daz notices a cocoon.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is a monk who uses his ability to shape water into blocks of ice to provide drinking water for the group. He is methodical and focused on practical survival solutions.
source_quote: When they next find water, he will use his ability to shape water to transform it into a block of ice.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz mutters that all they need is some water.
source_quote: All we need is some water,” mutters the monk.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz proposes using his ability to shape water into blocks of ice for storage.
source_quote: Daz then proposes an ingenious solution. When they next find water, he will use his ability to shape water to transform it into a block of ice.

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth covers the rear of the caravan to obscure evidence of their travels.
source_quote: Eldeth covers the rear as they travel, trying to obscure any evidence of their travels.

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth covers the rear of the caravan, obscuring evidence of the group’s passage. She is frequently annoyed by the excessive help offered by others, especially Daz and Grygum.
source_quote: Eldeth covers the rear as they travel, trying to obscure any evidence of their travels.

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth, experienced in spelunking, proposes a safety innovation: tying silk rope to mitigate falls from burning web segments; provides pragmatic, calm responses to escalating risk scenarios.
source_quote: We can tie some of the silk rope around each of us. That way, if one of us falls, the others can try to arrest his fall. ... Well, then the next person must. ... Then I suppose we all die.

subject: Fargas Rumblefoot
fact: Fargas Rumblefoot claims he is not infected because he escaped before being consumed.
source_quote: I am not infected. ... Most of the time, the gnolls just eat their victims.

subject: Fargas Rumblefoot
fact: Fargas Rumblefoot communicates telepathically with the group from inside the cocoon.
source_quote: I am Fargas Rumblefoot." ... "Can you please get me out of here?

subject: Fargas Rumblefoot
fact: Fargas Rumblefoot is a halfling trapped in a cocoon and claims to have been attacked by gnolls.
source_quote: I am Fargas Rumblefoot." ... "I was a member of an adventuring band looking for a lost tomb. Gnolls attacked us.

subject: Fargas Rumblefoot
fact: Fargas Rumblefoot is a halfling trapped in a cocoon, claiming he was attacked by gnolls and is now being stored as spider food. He insists he is not infected and possesses knowledge of a lost tomb and its treasure. He is currently aware that spiders are approaching and fears he will not be freed in time.
source_quote: I am not infected. Because I escaped. Most of the time, the gnolls just eat their victims. I am spider snack for later. Shit, I can feel the spiders coming. I have information. We were coming to look for a tomb. I know the location of the tomb. And more importantly, I know the location of the treasure.

subject: Fargas Rumblefoot
fact: Fargas Rumblefoot is a living halfling trapped in the cocoon and calls out telepathically for rescue.
source_quote: they hear the voice of a still living halfling in their heads. “I am Fargas Rumblefoot.” ... “Can you please get me out of here?”

subject: Fargas Rumblefoot
fact: Fargas Rumblefoot says he is being kept as spider food for later.
source_quote: I am spider snack for later.

subject: Fargas Rumblefoot
fact: Fargas Rumblefoot was part of an adventuring band that was attacked by gnolls.
source_quote: I was a member of an adventuring band looking for a lost tomb. Gnolls attacked us.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believes Jimjar will pay when he has money.
source_quote: he realizes that Jimjar will pay when he has money.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum initially moves to cut the cocoon but halts upon Thorin’s suggestion, showing deference to group consensus and belief in the moral weight of names, though he remains part of the final decision to act.
source_quote: He can't be evil with a name like that. But you’re right.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is a half-orc who steps in to make a bet with Jimjar after Zalthir refuses. He wins the bet and demonstrates a willingness to engage in risky gambles despite knowing the odds.
source_quote: Grygum steps forward, 'I’ll make that bet.'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is excited by new forms of speech; interprets Yukyuk’s acrobatics as a 'triple spin'; encourages Stool; and is the group’s enthusiastic observer of the goblins’ web-surfing techniques.
source_quote: That was an amazing triple spin! ... And we love you for it. ... They are good at surfing the web.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum makes a bet with Jimjar to navigate the bioluminescent passageway.
source_quote: But then Grygum steps forward, “I’ll make that bet.”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum mutters that the goblins are good at surfing the web.
source_quote: Grygum stares at them, slides on the strands, and mutters, “They are good at surfing the web.”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum realizes Jimjar has no 20 gold but assumes he will pay when he has money.
source_quote: Grygum realizes that the Jimjar doesn’t have 20 gold. He wonders whether to say anything to the goblins and realizes that Jimjar will pay when he has money.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum smiles and agrees to accompany Stool to the cocoon.
source_quote: Grygum smiles at Stool and says, “Yes, I will. Now let’s go together.”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum smiles and says they love Stool for being helpful.
source_quote: Grygum turns to him and smiles, “And we love you for it.”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum thinks the goblins can be easily dealt with if necessary.
source_quote: we could easily deal with them if it comes to that,” he thinks.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum wonders whether to tell the goblins that Jimjar doesn't have 20 gold.
source_quote: Grygum realizes that the Jimjar doesn’t have 20 gold. He wonders whether to say anything to the goblins

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is referenced as the authority who decides the fate of failed Drow.
source_quote: Ilvara might decide his fate should be precisely like Serith's

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar accepts the goblins’ proposal to guide the group until paid.
source_quote: Jimjar acts like this was the most awful idea he had ever heard, then pauses and sighs, “I suppose that will have to be the plan.”

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar explains that Barrelstalk mushrooms produce 1-4 gallons of water and five to 10 pounds of nutritious food.
source_quote: Jimjar explains that the Barrelstalk mushroom can produce 1-4 gallons of water and five to 10 pounds of nutritious food.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar is a botanist with deep knowledge of Underdark flora. He identifies and explains the properties of Barrelstalk mushrooms, Ormu moss, and Trillimac fungi. He is a compulsive gambler who makes high-risk bets, often against himself.
source_quote: Jimjar explains that the Barrelstalk mushroom can produce 1-4 gallons of water and five to 10 pounds of nutritious food.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar is referenced as owing 20 gold; lacks the funds to pay; is skeptical of proposals; mutters about being short of cash; and is indirectly criticized by Grygum for lacking the money to honor the bet.
source_quote: But I am a bit short of cash. ... And they are goblins; we could easily deal with them if it comes to that. ... He looks at the cleric and, with a twinkle in his eye, says, 'No.'

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar mutters that he is short of cash after losing the bet.
source_quote: Jimjar then looks into his pockets and mutters, “But I am a bit short of cash.”

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar refuses the flying bet, calling himself a gambler, not an idiot.
source_quote: Jimjar laughs, “I am a gambler, not an idiot.”

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith rouses the group each morning and is the first to recognize their arrival at the Silken Paths. He provides detailed knowledge of the structure and nature of the spiderweb network.
source_quote: Sarith rouses everyone in the morning, 'We must continue.'

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith rouses the group in the morning and declares they must continue.
source_quote: Sarith rouses everyone in the morning, “We must continue.”

subject: Sathir
fact: Sathir identifies their location as the Silken Paths.
source_quote: Sathir shouts, “YES!” ... “We have arrived at the Silken Paths. We are heading in the right direction.”

subject: Sathir
fact: Sathir, seeing the deal closed, gives the goblins their final directive: guide the group to a passageway leading quickly to Sloobludop.
source_quote: Take us to a passageway that will get us quickly to Sloobludop.

subject: Serith
fact: Serith is referenced as an example of a failed Drow’s fate.
source_quote: Ilvara might decide his fate should be precisely like Serith's

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar is a pragmatic member of the group who anticipates future water availability at the Darklake, offering reassurance amid scarcity.
source_quote: Shuushar sighed, 'Soon, we will be at the Darklake, and we will have more water than we ever knew what to do with it.'

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar mentions that they will soon reach the Darklake and have abundant water.
source_quote: Shuushar sighed, “Soon, we will be at the Darklake, and we will have more water than we ever knew what to do with it.”

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait claims he went around a spider and through its legs during the navigation.
source_quote: Yukyuk took the easy route. I went around the spider and through its legs.

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait is a goblin guide with a pink color motif and an odd accent with rolled R’s and clipped vowels.
source_quote: The second jump, whose color motif is pink, speaks with an odd accent: the R’s are rolled, and the vowels are clipped oddly. “And I am Spiderbait.”

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait is a goblin with a pink color motif, speaking with a rolled R accent and clipped vowels.
source_quote: The second jump, whose color motif is pink, speaks with an odd accent: the R’s are rolled, and the vowels are clipped oddly. “And I am Spiderbait.”

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait mutters that Yukyuk took the easy route while he went around the spider and through its legs.
source_quote: Spiderbait, seeing Grygum’s interest, mutters, “Yukyuk took the easy route. I went around the spider and through its legs.”

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait speaks with a pink color motif and a rolled-R, clipped-vowel accent; offers guiding services for 2 gold per day; expresses pride in the group’s success; and claims to have taken a more complex route through the spider’s legs rather than the easy path.
source_quote: And I am Spiderbait. We can be your guides at a nominal price of 2 gold per day. ... I went around the spider and through its legs. ... We are the best. We are going to have so much fun going through the web with you. And you are an awesome group.

subject: Stool
fact: Stool expresses excitement about being helpful and is invited by Grygum to accompany him to the cocoon.
source_quote: I’m helpful, aren’t I? I love being helpful." ... "Yes, I will. Now let’s go together.

subject: Stool
fact: Stool is activated to deploy spores; expresses excitement at being helpful; accompanies Grygum to investigate the moving cocoon; and is emotionally affirmed by the group.
source_quote: I’m helpful, aren’t I? I love being helpful. ... Are you going to come with me? ... Yes, I will. Now let’s go together.

subject: Stool
fact: Stool is asked to use his spores on the moving humanoid-sized cocoon.
source_quote: Zalthir notices it is moving and humanoid-sized. He turns to Stool, “We need those spores.”

subject: Stool
fact: Stool is excited to use his spores on the cocoon and offers to help.
source_quote: Stool is very excited, “I’m helpful, aren’t I? I love being helpful.”

subject: Stool
fact: Stool is very excited about being helpful.
source_quote: Stool is very excited, “I’m helpful, aren’t I? I love being helpful.”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin grabs Daz and nudges Stool to use his spores; observes the goblins coating their shoes with a peculiar substance and starting to run; later reacts with disbelief to Spiderbait’s revised guiding proposal.
source_quote: Thorin grabs Daz and nudges Stool to use his spores. ... Thorin observes them coat their shoes with a peculiar substance and start running.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a leader among the group who questions the nature of Fargas’s claims, suspects possible infection or deception, and ultimately decides to cut Fargas free with his blade after assessing the urgency and risk.
source_quote: Perhaps we should have him tell us who he is? I wonder if he’s already been infected? Like, do we free him, and we get a gnoll? I can cut him loose in a few seconds.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a member of the caravan who discovers a pool of water on the 8th day, enabling Daz to create ice blocks for the group.
source_quote: Thorin finds a pool of water.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin offers to cut Fargas Rumblefoot free from the cocoon in seconds.
source_quote: Thorin takes his blade, saying, “I can cut him loose in a few seconds.”

subject: Topsy and Turvy
fact: Topsy and Turvy are seen talking to each other but too far away for Daz to hear.
source_quote: Daz notices Topsy and Turvy talking to each other. But they are too far away for him to understand what they are saying.

subject: Topsy and Turvy
fact: Topsy and Turvy are seen talking to each other, but Daz cannot hear what they say.
source_quote: Daz notices Topsy and Turvy talking to each other. But they are too far away for him to understand what they are saying.

subject: Vof Klownits
fact: Vof Klownits is referenced as a Sage whose opus contains the maxim 'No plan survives encounter with the enemy.'
source_quote: Vof Klownits, a Sage, whose opus Zalthir has never read

subject: Yeenoghu
fact: Yeenoghu is the demon lord said to have created gnolls when he came to Faerûn.
source_quote: It is also said that they were created when the demon lord Yeenoghu found his way onto Faerûn and ran amok.

subject: Yukyuk
fact: Yukyuk excitedly describes his web-surfing maneuver after the bet, saying he did a twist and flip when strands broke.
source_quote: Oh, yeah, man. That was fun. Did you see me nail those tough strings? There was this one moment when I was taking a curve, and the strands broke, but I managed to do that twist and flip, and that's super cool.

subject: Yukyuk
fact: Yukyuk introduces himself with an orange color motif, later marches toward the web after tossing his beanie, and claims to be an expert web-surfer with dramatic flair, including a memorable twist-and-flip maneuver.
source_quote: My name is Yukyuk. Oh man, you’re not surfing. You’re walking. ... There was this one moment when I was taking a curve, and the strands broke, but I managed to do that twist and flip, and that's super cool.

subject: Yukyuk
fact: Yukyuk is a goblin guide with an orange color motif and wears a beanie.
source_quote: The first one, whose color motif is orange, introduces himself, “My name is Yukyuk.”

subject: Yukyuk
fact: Yukyuk is a goblin with an orange color motif, wearing relaxed clothing and a beanie, and speaks in goblin words written in draconic script.
source_quote: The first one, whose color motif is orange, introduces himself, “My name is Yukyuk.” ... dressed in relaxed, comfortable shoes, baggy pants, and shirts whose button reaches just above their knees, whose sleeves are particularly wide, and their heads are covered with beanies. Their bodies are covered in tattoos written in draconic. The spelling is wrong. And it’s only through happenstance that Zalthir realizes they are writing goblin words using a draconic script.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir agrees with Buppido about relying on the goblins.
source_quote: For once, Zalthir agrees.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir agrees with Buppido’s skepticism about the goblins.
source_quote: For once, Zalthir agrees.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir asks Jimjar if he can block the passageway without revealing their passage.
source_quote: Zalthir turns to Jimjar, “You’re good at hiding things.” ... “How about you block this passageway in a way that does not look like we were the cause?”

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir collects Ormu fungus for its phosphorescent pigment potential.
source_quote: Zalthir collects some fungi - “Never know when you need that kind of pigment.”

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir feels compelled to say they might not be able to pay if they die.
source_quote: Zalthir feels compelled to add, “If we don’t make it out alive, we won’t be able to pay.”

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir feels something in the environs of worry about the giant spiders.
source_quote: Zalthir is now, perhaps the word isn’t worried, but something in the environs of that sentiment

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is a former gambler turned monk who has vowed never to gamble again. He is intensely observant and uses psychological deduction to exploit Jimjar’s compulsive betting behavior. He is increasingly frustrated by the group’s lack of resources and Jimjar’s refusal to take losing sides.
source_quote: Zalthir tries to test his theory, 'I’ll bet you can’t fly to the roof of this cavern?'

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is methodical and probing, pressing Fargas on his immunity to infection and questioning whether Thorin can carry him or if freeing him will take time, showing concern for tactical efficiency and hidden dangers.
source_quote: Why aren’t you infected? Can you carry him, or will we need to spend minutes to free him?

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is the group’s most analytical and cautious voice; questions trust, payment, survival, and the nature of the web; observes the spiders and the goblins’ behavior; and ultimately agrees with Buppido’s skepticism.
source_quote: That sounds fascinating, but given the complexity of your moves, how are we supposed to get across? ... If we don’t make it out alive, we won’t be able to pay. ... For once, Zalthir agrees.

subject: Zarith
fact: Zarith mutters about Jimjar’s wordplay; questions the goblins’ understanding of the bet; and later becomes the group’s primary skeptic regarding trust and survival, voicing concerns about web navigation and payment.
source_quote: Jimjar, you seem to have a knack with words. ... Do they know which side of the bet they made? ... But when we walk on the web, the spiders will hear our vibrations. Won’t that attract them to us?

subject: Barrelstalk mushrooms
fact: Barrelstalk mushrooms are a type of Underdark fungus that produces 1–4 gallons of water and 5–10 pounds of nutritious food. They are vital to the group’s survival.
source_quote: Jimjar explains that the Barrelstalk mushroom can produce 1-4 gallons of water and five to 10 pounds of nutritious food.

subject: beanies
fact: Yukyuk and Spiderbait wear beanies covering their heads.
source_quote: their heads are covered with beanies.

subject: cocoon
fact: A humanoid-sized cocoon is found on the web, and it is moving.
source_quote: Daz notices a cocoon. Zalthir notices it is moving and humanoid-sized.

subject: cocoon
fact: A humanoid-sized cocoon is observed moving on the web.
source_quote: Daz notices a cocoon. Zalthir notices it is moving and humanoid-sized.

subject: Ormu
fact: Ormu is a fungus that sheds dim light for 5 feet and can be dried into phosphorescent powder or pigment.
source_quote: Jimjar explains that it is a fungus called “Ormu. In addition to shedding a dim light for 5 feet, it can be harvested, dried, and made into a phosphorescent powder or pigment.”

subject: Ormu moss
fact: Ormu is a bioluminescent moss that emits a dim light for 5 feet and can be dried into a phosphorescent powder or pigment. Zalthir collects it for potential future use.
source_quote: Jimjar explains that it is a fungus called 'Ormu. In addition to shedding a dim light for 5 feet, it can be harvested, dried, and made into a phosphorescent powder or pigment.'

subject: Ormu pigment
fact: Zalthir collects some Ormu moss for use as pigment.
source_quote: Zalthir collects some fungi - “Never know when you need that kind of pigment.”

subject: Silk Rope
fact: Silk rope is harvested from the web and tied around each group member as a safety measure to arrest falls during web destruction events.
source_quote: We can tie some of the silk rope around each of us. That way, if one of us falls, the others can try to arrest his fall.

subject: silk rope
fact: The group ties silk rope around themselves to mitigate falls from the web.
source_quote: We can tie some of the silk rope around each of us. That way, if one of us falls, the others can try to arrest his fall.

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: spiderweb strands
fact: Spiderweb strands can be severed with fire or a blade to control movement or escape.
source_quote: They can stop the spiders and escape if they cut the strands in the right places. They will get trapped if they cut the strands in the wrong place.

subject: Spores
fact: Spores are a biological tool wielded by Stool; deployed to investigate the moving cocoon; and treated as a critical asset for survival.
source_quote: We need those spores. ... I’m helpful, aren’t I? I love being helpful.

subject: tattoos
fact: Yukyuk and Spiderbait have tattoos written in draconic script spelling goblin words incorrectly.
source_quote: Their bodies are covered in tattoos written in draconic. The spelling is wrong. And it’s only through happenstance that Zalthir realizes they are writing goblin words using a draconic script.

subject: Thorin’s blade
fact: Thorin’s blade is the instrument chosen to free Fargas from the cocoon, deemed capable of cutting through the material in seconds, making it the decisive tool in the group’s action.
source_quote: I can cut him loose in a few seconds.

subject: Trillimac cap
fact: The cap of the Trillimac mushroom can be cut and cleaned for use in making maps, hats, and scrolls.
source_quote: The cap’s leathery surface can be cut and cleaned for use in making maps, hats, and scrolls (its surface takes on dyes and inks well).

subject: Trillimac food yield
fact: Additional Trillimac mushrooms can produce 20 pounds of food.
source_quote: That one will be worth 6 pounds of food.

subject: Trillimac mushroom
fact: One Trillimac mushroom yields 6 pounds of food.
source_quote: “That one will be worth 6 pounds of food.”

subject: Trillimac mushrooms
fact: Trillimac is a large mushroom with a leathery cap that can be processed into materials for maps, hats, and scrolls, and a stalk that yields bread-like food. It grows to 4–5 feet tall and is rare and valuable.
source_quote: Jimjar, a botanist, explains it is a mushroom that grows to a height of four to five feet and has a broad gray-green cap and a light gray stalk.

subject: Trillimac stalk
fact: The stalk of the Trillimac mushroom can be soaked in water and dried to make palatable bread-like food.
source_quote: The stalk can be cleaned, soaked in water for an hour, then dried to make a palatable food akin to bread.

subject: burning the web
fact: A past Drow wizard attempted to burn the Silken Paths but failed as spiders rebuilt the webs faster.
source_quote: Do you remember that crazy Drow wizard who wanted to burn this place down? But the spiders kept rebuilding it faster than he could burn.

subject: Cocoon Identity
fact: The nature and origin of the humanoid-sized moving cocoon remain unknown; its potential threat or significance is unresolved and tied to Stool’s spores.
source_quote: Zalthir notices it is moving and humanoid-sized. ... We need those spiders.

subject: Fargas Rumblefoot's tomb location
fact: Fargas Rumblefoot claims to know the location of a lost tomb and its treasure.
source_quote: I have information. We were coming to look for a tomb. I know the location of the tomb. And more importantly, I know the location of the treasure.

subject: gnoll infection risk
fact: Thorin fears that freeing Fargas Rumblefoot may release a gnoll spawn.
source_quote: I wonder if he’s already been infected? Like, do we free him, and we get a gnoll?

subject: Infection risk
fact: There is an unresolved thread concerning whether freeing Fargas will result in the emergence of a gnoll or some other contagion, despite his denial — a fear echoed by the group’s traumatic memories and lore.
source_quote: I am not infected. That’s what everyone thinks, and then it’s the apocalypse.

subject: Jimjar's betting behavior
fact: Zalthir observes that Jimjar makes bad bets and may continue making them, implying a pattern of exploitable behavior.
source_quote: Zalthir is baffled and intrigued, “He bet against himself even though he knew the odds of winning that bet were terrible. His willingness to make these bad bets implies he will make further bad bets going forward.”

subject: Payment Obligation
fact: The group’s survival hinges on the goblins’ reliability and the unresolved debt of 20 gold owed by Jimjar, creating persistent tension about trust and financial accountability.
source_quote: But I am a bit short of cash. ... If we don’t make it out alive, we won’t be able to pay.

subject: Spider Sensitivity
fact: Whether the group’s vibrations on the web will attract spiders despite ambient noise remains uncertain; the goblins’ confidence is not backed by empirical evidence.
source_quote: They won’t notice your bouncing scales. ... But when we walk on the web, the spiders will hear our vibrations. Won’t that attract them to us?

subject: The location of the lost tomb
fact: Fargas knows the location of a lost tomb and its treasure, but the location is not revealed in this session.
source_quote: I know the location of the tomb. And more importantly, I know the location of the treasure.

subject: Topsy and Turvy’s secret conversation
fact: Topsy and Turvy are talking to each other while the group sleeps, but their dialogue is too distant to be heard. Their secrecy suggests hidden knowledge or a plot that may influence the group’s future.
source_quote: Daz notices Topsy and Turvy talking to each other. But they are too far away for him to understand what they are saying.

subject: Zalthir’s betting theory
fact: Zalthir has developed a psychological theory that Jimjar will continue to make irrational, self-sabotaging bets. He is testing this theory by provoking Jimjar into betting against himself, believing that if he can force Jimjar to take the losing side, he will win.
source_quote: His willingness to make these bad bets implies he will make further bad bets going forward.

subject: Zalthir's betting theory
fact: Zalthir theorizes that Jimjar’s willingness to make bad bets implies he will continue making them.
source_quote: His willingness to make these bad bets implies he will make further bad bets going forward.
